definition: Detects an imminent natural hazard and generates or issues warnings. Monitoring or forecasting without warning issuance is insufficient.
Disseminates hazard warnings through mobile-network cell broadcast. Excludes SMS unless separately described.

type_name: Other public warning channels and last-mile reach
definition: Disseminates public hazard warnings through SMS, apps, sirens, radio, television or community channels. Excludes cell broadcast, which has its own type.
Directs hazard warnings to identified institutions, staff, responders or road users to trigger protective action. Audience must be explicit.
Issues sector-specific warnings with an explicit climate or natural-hazard connection, such as climate-sensitive disease or pest warnings. Generic surveillance is insufficient.
Implements common alert formats or technical links between warning systems, such as the Common Alerting Protocol. Formal sector rules may separately qualify as climate_governance.
